title: Temporal Usage Patterns
insights:
Dataset Summary

The dataset contains a total of 14,985 events recorded from 14,985 users over a period from November 27, 2025 to February 19, 2026. There are 109 unique event types categorized under application-level events.

Temporal Analysis Findings

The analysis of the day x hour distribution reveals the following:

  • Peak Hour: 9 AM
  • Off-Peak Hour: 9 PM
  • Peak Day: Saturday
  • Lowest Usage Day: Wednesday
  • Peak-to-Trough Ratio: 338.0

Analysis

PUSH NOTIFICATION TIMING

To maximize open rates for push notifications, the marketing team should target the peak usage times. The optimal times for sending push notifications are:

  • Days: Saturday
  • Hour: 9 AM

CAPACITY PLANNING

The app requires maximum server capacity during peak usage times, particularly on:

  • Saturday at 9 AM

Given the peak-to-trough ratio of 338.0, there are significant traffic spikes that should be anticipated and planned for, especially on weekends.

MARKETING WINDOWS

The best times for running in-app promotions or flash sales are during peak usage hours, particularly:

  • Saturday at 9 AM

This timing aligns with when users are most active, ensuring higher engagement rates for promotions.

WEEKEND VS WEEKDAY

The usage pattern indicates that the app is likely more oriented towards leisure travel rather than commuting, as evidenced by:

  • Peak usage on Saturday
  • Lowest usage on Wednesday

This suggests that the user demographic may include individuals who travel for leisure on weekends rather than daily commuters.
